title: Refactor physics step into integrate(); tune jump feel
body:
step() had grown into one big wall of code, so I pulled the velocity + collision part out into integrate(). Same math, just a lot easier to read now.

While I was in there I tweaked two things for jump feel:

- coyote time 4 -> 6 frames. 4 was too strict, kept eating the jump right at the edge of the ferry
- terminal fall speed 18 -> 22 for snappier landings, long drops felt floaty

No other behaviour changes. Own tests pass and I ran through the first few platforms by hand, feels good.
